Stereon benchmark trend

stereon_bench on every push to main: the median CPU time per evaluated item (per iteration where nothing is counted) over the repetitions of each run, the last 60 runs. Latest: 30e35bc on 2026-11-24, Intel(R) Xeon(R) 6975P-C. Hosted runners differ from run to run, so a step in a chart is read against the CPU in its points' titles. The change shown is against the run before; above 10% it is marked.
